items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: In fact I worked up in Syracuse with him with Pepper Adams, you know he had a group up there.

ctx.x: I had one big band album, with a lot of the New York people. One of the things I had was do you remember a fellow Teddy Cohen? Vibe player? In fact I worked up in Syracuse with him with Pepper Adams, you know he had a group up there. Well anyhow he wrote, Hall Overton, who wrote the thing for Monk. I was studying with him for a little while, and he was too busy because I wanted him to write some music, so he asked Teddy Charles, Teddy Cohen, he changed his name, to write this string quartet album.
